rules: Consent is scoped to one represented context and time.
Consent to a date is not consent to relationship commitment.
Consent to a relationship is not automatic consent to adult intimacy.
Prior intimacy is not consent to later intimacy.
Rank, authority, friendship, gifts, favors, attraction and repeated requests do not establish consent.
Decline or withdrawal ends the current consent path without requiring hostility.
The player consent state is always explicit player input.
AI may phrase a consensual or declined interaction only from authoritative consent state.
